services.label: GitHub
services.desc: Where cornfield lives: the repo, its issues and pull requests, the actions CI runs, and the default forge of a repo's config.
services.breaks: Now: no pull request can be opened, checked or merged, and a GitHub sign-in (v1) fails. At the next CI run: the checks cannot start.

services.label: npm registry
services.desc: npm ci in CI and in the image; where a release publishes the package under both its names.
services.breaks: At the next CI run or image build: the dev dependencies cannot install. A release cannot publish.

services.label: Docker Hub
services.breaks: At the next image build: a fresh machine cannot pull the base image.

services.label: GitHub Container Registry
services.desc: Where a release pushes the cornfield image, and where an always-on install pulls it from.
services.breaks: At the next release or install: the image cannot be pushed or pulled; a running one keeps running.

uses.label: the release pushes the image
uses.why: The registry is named in the release workflow's with: block, which the CI detector does not read
